[[Basketball League of Serbia]] | team = Mega Basket | number = 6 | birth_date = {{birth date and age|2005|7|12|df=y}} | birth_place = [[Užice]], [[Serbia and Montenegro]] | nationality = Serbian | draft_year = | career_start = 2023 | years1 = 2023–present | team1 = [[KK Mega Basket|Mega Basket]] | years2 = 2023–2024 | team2 = → [[OKK Beograd]] | highlights = * [[ABA League Top Prospect]] ([[2024–25 ABA League First Division|2025]]) * [[Euroleague Basketball Next Generation Tournament|Euroleague NGT]] champion (2022) * 3× [[Junior ABA League]] champion ([[2021–22 Junior ABA League|2022]]–[[2023–24 Junior ABA League|2024]]) * [[Junior ABA League MVP]] (2024) * [[Junior ABA League Ideal Starting Five|Junior ABA League Ideal Starting 5]] (2024) | medal_templates = {{MedalSport|Men's basketball}} {{MedalCountry|{{Flagu|Serbia}}}} {{MedalCompetition|[[FIBA U18 European Championship]]}} {{MedalGold|[[2023 FIBA U18 European Championship|2023 Serbia]]|[[Serbia men's national under-18 basketball team|Team]]}} }} '''Bogoljub Marković''' ({{lang-sr-cyr|Богољуб Марковић}}; born 12 July 2005) is a Serbian professional [[basketball]] player for [[KK Mega Basket|Mega Basket]] of the [[Adriatic League]] and the [[Basketball League of Serbia]]. Standing at {{height|m=2.10}}, he plays at the [[Power forward (basketball)|power forward]] position. ==Professional career== In October 2023, [[KK Mega Basket|Mega Basket]] loaned Marković to [[OKK Beograd]] for the [[2023–24 Basketball League of Serbia]]. Over 28 regular season games, he averaged 17.9 points, 9.1 rebounds, and 2.1 assists per game.{{cite web |title=Bogoljub Marković, OKK Beograd |url=https://kls.rs/igrac/?igrac=149&t=1714818259 |website=kls.rs |access-date=4 May 2024}} Marković was named to the All-First Team [[Basketball League of Serbia]] and was the leading rebounder of the regular season.{{cite web |title=Prvotimac plavo-belih Bogoljub Marković u najboljoj petorki lige |url=http://www.okkbeograd.org.rs/en/prvotimac-plavo-belih-bogoljub-markovic-u-najboljoj-petorki-lige/ |website=okkbeograd.org.rs |access-date=4 May 2024}} On 26 April 2024, Marković declared for the [[2024 NBA draft]],{{cite web |title=Veliki talenat srpske košarke ide na NBA draft: Zablistao na Evropskom, bio prvi skakač domaće lige, sad gleda ka Americi |url=https://nova.rs/sport/kosarka/veliki-talenat-srpske-kosarke-ide-na-nba-draft-zablistao-na-evropskom-bio-prvi-skakac-domace-lige-sad-gleda-ka-americi/ |website=nova.rs |access-date=4 May 2024}} but later withdrew.{{cite web |title=31 early entry candidates withdraw from 2024 NBA Draft|url=https://www.nba.com/news/31-early-entry-candidates-withdraw-2024-nba-draft|website=nba.com|access-date=12 August 2024}} ==National team career== Marković was a member of the [[Serbia men's national under-18 basketball team|Serbian under-18 team]] that won the gold medal at the [[2023 FIBA U18 European Championship]] in [[Serbia]]. Over seven tournament games, he averaged 14.1 points, 7.0 rebounds and 1.7 assists per game.{{cite web |title=Bogoljub Markovic 2023 FIBA Profile |url=https://www.fiba.basketball/europe/u18/2023/player/Bogoljub-Markovic |website=fiba.basketball |accessdate=4 May 2024}} He was selected to the All-Star Five Team of the championship.{{cite web |title=Serbia star Topic takes home MVP award |url=https://www.fiba.basketball/europe/u18/2023/news/serbia-star-topic-takes-home-mvp-award |website=fiba.basketball |accessdate=4 May 2024}} On 24 November 2024, Marković made his debut for the [[Serbia men's national basketball team|Serbian senior national team]] in a win against [[Denmark men's national basketball team|Denmark]] in [[Belgrade]] during the [[EuroBasket 2025 qualification]].{{cite web |title=Marković: Velika čast raditi sa selektorom|url=https://www.zurnal.rs/sr/clanak/200842/kosarka/reprezentacija/markovic-velika-cast-raditi-sa-selektorom|website=zurnal.rs|access-date=27 November 2024}} ==References== {{reflist}} ==External links== * [https://www.aba-liga.com/player/3833/23/1/bogoljub-markovic/ Bogoljub Marković] at aba-liga.com * [https://basketball.realgm.com/player/Bogoljub-Markovic/Summary/182945 Bogoljub Marković] at [[realgm.com]] * [https://www.proballers.com/basketball/player/237519/bogoljub-markovic Bogoljub Marković] at proballers.com {{KK Mega Basket current roster}} {{ABA League Top Prospect}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Markovic, Bogoljub}} [[Category:2005 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:ABA League players]] [[Category:Basketball League of Serbia players]] [[Category:KK Mega Basket players]] [[Category:OKK Beograd players]] [[Category:Power forwards]]
